review of optimizing clinical complexity around fever in Narketpally"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Draft ???\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E17\/05\/2025\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EDraft: Optimizing Clinical Complexity Around Fever in Narketpally\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EIntroduction\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nFebrile Illness is among the most commonly seen clinical symptomatology and presents a\u0026nbsp; diagnostic challenge in resource-limited and epidemiologically complex regions like Narketpally, Telangana. This semi-urban setting experiences a broad spectrum of febrile illnesses influenced by seasonal patterns, endemic infections, and a dual burden of communicable and non-communicable diseasesThis review of 77 cases of a wide array of fever diagosis and its management would help us understand the challenges faced by healthcare providers and patients to the challenges faced with this clinical complexity. Optimizing the clinical approach to fever in such a context necessitates a refined, context-specific strategy.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EClinical Complexities and Challenges\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cul\u003E\n\u003Cli\u003E\n\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EDiagnostic Overlap\u003C\/strong\u003E: The overlapping symptomatology of many febrile illnesses, such as myalgia, rash, and headache, complicates early diagnosis.\u003C\/p\u003E\n\u003C\/li\u003E\n\u003Cli\u003E\n\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EResource Limitations\u003C\/strong\u003E: Limited access to advanced diagnostic tests and imaging in peripheral or primary care settings often leads to over-reliance on clinical judgment.\u003C\/p\u003E\n\u003C\/li\u003E\n\u003Cli\u003E\n\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EAntibiotic Misuse\u003C\/strong\u003E: Due to diagnostic uncertainty and patient expectations, empirical antibiotic usage is high, increasing the risk of antimicrobial resistance.\u003C\/p\u003E\n\u003C\/li\u003E\n\u003Cli\u003E\n\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EContinuity of Care\u003C\/strong\u003E: Follow-up is often inadequate due to lack of health records, high patient volume, and socioeconomic barriers.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\n\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003ECASE REVIEW\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003EEnteric fever -\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003Efungal -\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003Eleptospirosis -\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003Emalaria -\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003Esle -\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003Eunclassified -\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003Edengue -\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003Eculture positive -\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EConclusion\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003EThe future of addressing fever and its complexities would involve making PaJR groups to do a root cause analysis , to determine the underlying epidemiological cause of the illness , be it , overcrowding leading to communicable infectious illnesses or a family history of lymphoma causing 'B'-symptoms . font-family: \u0026quot;Times New Roman\u0026quot;, serif; font-size: 15.9991px;\"\u003EDandy-Walker malformation or syndrome is a rare congenital neurological anomaly that affects the development of the cerebellum, the region of the brain responsible for motor coordination and balance. This posterior fossa anomaly is characterized by agenesis or hypoplasia of the vermis and cystic enlargement of the fourth ventricle, causing upward displacement of the tentorium and torcula. Most patients have hydrocephalus at the time of diagnosis. Dandy-Walker malformation is the most common posterior fossa malformation, and it typically occurs sporadically.\u0026nbsp;The syndrome\u0026nbsp;can manifest with a wide spectrum of neurological and developmental symptoms, making timely recognition and management crucial for improving patient outcomes\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECASE REPORT\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 13 year old boy presented to the general medicine OPD of KIMS, Narketpally on 17th May 2025 , with the following complaints\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Edribbling of urine from the back of the penis\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Einability to stand up from a squatting position\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehe has a history of difficulty in sucking , he even had difficulty breast feeding as an infant .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr platform "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;I am Dr.Anahita Behara from KIMS,Nkp and today I shall demonstrate the benefits of a case based learning ecosystem (CCBLE) , as a budding medical student full of curiosity ,\u0026nbsp; i was fascinated by the revelling mystery of the numerous diseases encountered during my study . I was deeply disturbed\u0026nbsp; by my inability to make a change . I had such big dreams but no way of achieveing them , until I was introduced to the concept of Case-based learning or\u0026nbsp; Patient-centric learning , following up on patients even after they were discharged and monitoring their lifestyle habits , gave us a window to view not only the \"dis-ease\" but the \"ease\" as well , linking all the domains of health .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt humanises the patient and forces us to look at the bigger picture.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E"},"link":[{"rel":"replies","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/anahitabehara.blogspot.com\/feeds\/8297243768475963734\/comments\/default","title":"Post Comments"},{"rel":"replies","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/anahitabehara.blogspot.com\/2024\/09\/pajr.html#comment-form","title":"0 Comments"},{"rel":"edit","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/5185626995315512470\/posts\/default\/8297243768475963734"},{"rel":"self","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/5185626995315512470\/posts\/default\/8297243768475963734"},{"rel":"alternate","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/anahitabehara.blogspot.com\/2024\/09\/pajr.html","title":"PaJR platform "}],"author":[{"name":{"$t":"Anahita Behara"},"uri":{"$t":"http:\/\/www.blogger.com\/profile\/08894824984680371698"},"email":{"$t":"noreply@blogger.com"},"gd$image":{"rel":"http://schemas.google.com/g/2005#thumbnail","width":"16","height":"16","src":"https:\/\/img1.blogblog.com\/img\/b16-rounded.gif"}}],"thr$total":{"$t":"0"}}]}}
